_meta.description: Known mistakes/lessons for papyrus. New entries only get added via ChangeGate's approve() (change_gate.py) -- never edited by hand as a shortcut around review.

patterns.whatToLookFor: Tells the user to check for a vanilla script's .pex as a loose file in Data\Scripts (e.g. Data\Scripts\WorkshopObjectScript.pex) and, if it's not there, to verify game files or reinstall Fallout 4.
patterns.correction: Vanilla .pex files are packed inside the base game archive "Fallout4 - Misc.ba2", not loose in Data\Scripts, so on a normal install they will never appear there and that is not a problem. Loose .pex files in Data\Scripts come from mods. Only suggest verifying or reinstalling the game if the BA2 archive itself is missing or damaged; never tell the user a vanilla script is missing just because no loose copy exists.
